name: Fir Dea

attributes.attribute: another name for the Tuatha De Danann

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fir Dea is an Irish name for a mythical people. The term points to the Tuatha De Danann. For the full account of this race, see the entry on the Tuatha De Danann.

okr.objective: Fir Dea is a cross-reference to the Tuatha De Danann.
